exempt.Spot.ZkMain: the spot-one-stage-zk executable's entry point, one line; its command is Spot.OneStageZk.membersMain, audited under Spot
exempt.Spot.VerifierMain: the spot-verifier executable's entry point, one line; it serves Spot.Pieces.verifier, audited under Spot
exempt.Spot.PlanCheckMain: the spot-plancheck executable's entry point: it reads JSON lines into Spot.PlanCheck's designs and answers leakBound and checkWork, audited under Spot
exempt.Spot.MonitoringPeriodMain: the spot-monitoring-period executable's entry point, one line; its command is Core.BlobProtocol.main over Spot.MonitoringPeriod.protocol, audited under Spot

Spot.why: the port is code: Lean core, C-Flock's verifier library, the core protocol interface, the LMS verifier (the challenger's signed record) and Lean's hash map (R3's port index, `Registration.portIndex`), no Mathlib and nothing of Security (the layout rule: Lean code never requires Security)

Spot.RecordText.why: what an execution phase's circuit record's text declares is code, read from the decoded Program and the parsed text alone: Flock's program decoder and template queries, a type's bits read from its structure (Flock.Sigma, which imports the decoder alone) and SPOT's reader of the record's wires; nothing else of SPOT, no Mathlib and nothing of Security
